catalog.retire_plan_description: Move every workspace of a plan to another one and close it to sign-ups
catalog.editor_preview_description: See the plan card as customers see it and its Stripe sync status while editing

catalog.migration_detail_description: See a plan migration workspace by workspace, settle uncertain moves, retry failed ones and close it

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Subscription plans, pricing, features and trial settings. The order below is the order customers see on the pricing page.
plans.create_hint: Start blank or duplicate an existing plan to keep its features.
plans.reorder_hint: Drag a card by its handle to reorder. Saved instantly.
plans.reorder_failed: The new order was not saved
plans.reorder_failed_hint: The plans are back in their saved order. Try again.
plans.features_failed: Couldn’t load the features: the cards show the plans without them.

column.mrr_description: Normalised: yearly ÷ 12, seats counted, trials and complimentary access excluded.

action.stop_selling_success: The plan is no longer on sale.
action.put_on_sale_success: The plan is on sale again.

stop_selling.title: Stop selling {name}?
stop_selling.description_in_use: {name} disappears from the pricing page and sign-up. Nobody is moved: current customers stay on it and keep being billed. To move them to another plan, use Retire plan… instead.
stop_selling.description_unused: No workspace uses {name}, so nobody is affected. It disappears from the pricing page; put it back on sale any time.

delete.title: Delete plan {name}?
delete.description: No workspace uses {name}. The plan and its feature settings are deleted; this can’t be undone.
delete.blocked_description: Delete is available once no workspace uses the plan. Retire it first to move its {count} workspaces to another plan.

empty.title: No plans yet
empty.description: Customers can’t sign up until at least one plan is on sale.
empty.error_description: The catalogue didn’t answer. Plans and prices are unchanged.

empty_display.first_run_description: Customers can’t sign up until at least one plan is on sale. Create one, or duplicate an existing plan to keep its features.
empty_display.on_sale_description: Customers can’t sign up until at least one plan is on sale.
empty_display.legacy_description: Plans you stop selling show here, kept for the workspaces still on them.
empty_display.filtered_description: Try another name, or clear the search.

stats.label: Catalogue at a glance
stats.legacy_none: No workspace left on a legacy plan

card.members: Up to {count} member | Up to {count} members

editor.new_description: A new subscription plan. Its Stripe product and price are created when you save.
editor.edit_description: Pricing changes are synced to Stripe when you save.
editor.limit_error: A cap must be at least 1 member. For no cap, tick Unlimited.

notice.price_changed: A new Stripe price was created
notice.price_changed_description: New sign-ups pay the new price. Existing subscribers keep theirs until you migrate them.

section.identity_description: How the plan is named and pitched to customers.
section.pricing_description: What a workspace pays, excluding tax. VAT is added at checkout from the customer’s country.
section.access_description: What workspaces on this plan can do. Values show exactly as customers see them.
section.limits_description: Hard caps checked when someone invites a member.
section.visibility_description: Where the plan appears and how its card stands out.

field.name: Name
field.description_description: Pitch shown on the pricing page and plan cards. Two lines fit.
field.audience_description: Businesses must enter a company name and VAT number at sign-up.
field.price_description: Base price for one billing period, in the currency below.
field.price_hint: Typed in the currency’s main unit: 34.50 for €34.50.
field.billing_mode_description: Per seat bills every member; seat changes are prorated.
field.trial_days_description: No card needed during the trial. Set 0 for none.
field.access_description: The plan it builds on, its feature values and its permissions.
field.max_members_description: Workspaces already above the cap keep everyone but can’t invite more.
field.is_active_description: When off, current customers stay on it but nobody new can subscribe.
field.is_public_description: Listed on the pricing page and at sign-up. Hidden plans are assigned by a platform admin.
field.order_description: Position on the pricing page, from 0. Also changed by dragging cards on the Plans page.
field.badge_description: Short label on top of the card, like “Popular”. Leave empty for none.
field.badge_color_description: Colour of the badge and the card’s outline.

billing_mode_hint.flat: One price per workspace, whatever the team size
billing_mode_hint.seat: Price × members, e.g. 6 members pay 6 times the price

access.parent_hint: This plan follows {parent} live: when {parent} changes, rows marked “Inherited” change too. Overridden rows keep their own value.
access.no_parent_hint: Pick a parent plan to inherit its features and permissions.
access.no_features: No feature yet. Create features to switch them on or limit them per plan.
access.permissions_parent: {granted} of {total} · inherited from {parent}, plus {added} added on this plan
access.load_failed: Couldn’t load the features and permissions. The plan’s saved access is unchanged.

feature.limit_error: A limit must be at least 1. To block it, pick Off.

permissions.title: Permissions on {name}
permissions.description_parent: {granted} of {total} granted. Rows tagged {parent} come from the parent plan.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.failed: Couldn’t load the preview. Editing still works.

stripe.title: Stripe sync
stripe.on_save: A new Stripe price of {price} ({interval}) is created and used for new sign-ups. Existing subscribers keep {previous} until migrated. {count} workspaces are on this plan.

retire.title: Retire {name}
retire.subtitle_1: Move every workspace to another plan, then delete {name} once none is left.
retire.subtitle_2: Pick where the {count} workspaces go and check what changes for them.
retire.subtitle_3: Check the impact, then type the plan’s key to confirm.
retire.closed_note: Retiring closes {name} to sign-ups at once: no workspace can join it while its workspaces move.
retire.open_migration: A migration of this plan is running or waits for an operator. Settle it in Plan migrations first.
retire.no_target: No other plan is on sale to move the workspaces to. Put one on sale first.
retire.price_lost: The target costs more: workspaces pay more from their next invoice.
retire.price_gained: The target costs less: nobody is charged more.
retire.price_same: Same price, so nobody is charged more.
retire.pick_target: Pick a target plan to see what changes.
retire.above_cap: {count} workspace is above {cap}: it keeps everyone but can’t invite | {count} workspaces are above {cap}: they keep everyone but can’t invite
retire.notify_hint: {count} recipient · sent when each workspace moves | {count} recipients · sent when each workspace moves
retire.confirm_title: Retire {name} and move {count} workspace to {target}? | Retire {name} and move {count} workspaces to {target}?
retire.confirm_description: {name} is closed to sign-ups now and kept until no workspace is left on it. Failures stay on {name} and appear in Plan migrations for a retry.
retire.confirm: Retire plan and move {count} | Retire plan and move {count}

migrations.title: Plan migrations
migrations.description: Moves of workspaces from one plan to another, started when a plan is retired. Failed workspaces stay on their old plan until retried.
migrations.caption: Migrations
migrations.footer_hint: Progress refreshes while a migration runs.
migrations.detail_description: Workspaces moved, not moved, and what is left to settle.

attention.uncertain: Some workspaces didn’t move, one at least with an uncertain Stripe state: check it in Stripe before retrying.
attention.failed: Some workspaces didn’t move. Retry them, or mark the migration as reconciled.
attention.empty_description: Every migration moved its workspaces or was reconciled.

empty.title: No migration yet
empty.description: Retiring a plan moves its workspaces to another one; each move shows here.

detail.uncertain_hint: The move was cut short: Stripe may or may not have switched the subscription, so a retry could charge twice. Check it in Stripe first.
detail.failed_hint: Still on {from}; nothing was charged. It can be retried.
detail.permissions_changed: Permissions: {added} added, {removed} removed from their roles’ reach.
detail.no_workspace: No workspace was on the plan when the migration started.

resolve.moved_description: Do this only if Stripe bills {name} on {to}. The DMS moves it to {to} and applies its permissions; nothing is sent to Stripe.
resolve.not_moved_description: Do this only if Stripe still bills {name} on {from}. It stays on {from} and can be retried.

retry.title: Retry moving {name} to {to}? | Retry moving {count} workspaces to {to}?
retry.description: Stripe charges the prorated difference again. A workspace failing a second time stays on {from}.

reconcile.title: Close this migration with {count} workspace left on {from}? | Close this migration with {count} workspaces left on {from}?
reconcile.description: They stay on {from} and keep being billed as today. {from} can’t be deleted while a workspace uses it.
reconcile.note_placeholder: Why these workspaces stay where they are
reconcile.note_required: Write a note for the audit log.

features.title: Features
features.description: What plans can switch on or limit. Each feature becomes a row of the comparison table on the pricing page, in this order.
features.caption: Features
features.footer_hint: Drag rows to change the order on the pricing page.

column.display_name_description: Name shown to platform admins and customers.
column.description_description: Shown under the name in the comparison table.
column.value_type_description: Locked while plans store a value: their values would no longer read.
column.is_detail_row_description: Keeps the table short. Visitors expand it to see this row.
column.tooltip_description: Optional hint shown next to the feature in the comparison table.

placeholder.tooltip: Counted across all projects, including backups

form.new_description: A row of the comparison table plans switch on or limit.
form.edit_description: Changes show on the pricing page at once.

empty.title: No features yet
empty.description: Features are what plans switch on or limit, row by row in the comparison table.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: No plan uses it. The row disappears from the comparison table. This can’t be undone.
delete.blocked_title: {name} is used by {count} plan | {name} is used by {count} plans
delete.blocked_description: Deleting it would change what workspaces on those plans can do. Switch it off on each plan first, or hide it from the comparison table instead.
